To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we provide a solution that enables users with limited skills to modify 3D architectural models by simply dragging and dropping vertices, (2) we provide a system that enables users to interact with 3D architectural content in a virtual reality setting by using gestures, (3) we provide a method that enables users to virtually change the day and the time of year at which a photograph was taken.

our work allows users to create 3D architectural content by simply manipulating vertices of a 3D model, while also adapting textures, and to modify the light distribution in tree canopy using a single scattering volume approach.
we present solutions to assist users in creating 3D content, by allowing them to make simple changes to the 2D input image, and to the 3d model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of interactive tools for non-experts to assist in content creation.
the creation of interactive tools that allow users to easily manipulate 3D models and images.
the creation of tools that can be easily used by non-experts, while providing the same capabilities as current tools targeted at expert users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the contributions of this thesis are the following : 1) a simple and efficient tool for 3D content editing, 2) a tool for 3d content creation and editing in an immersive virtual environment, and 3) an efficient tool for changing the lighting of a photograph.
the thesis presents solutions to bridge the gap between content creators and the content creation tools.
the thesis presents solutions to bridge the gap between content creation tools and the non-expert user.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide tools for interactive content creation that are accessible to non-experts.
this thesis proposes solutions to assist non-experts with content creation for virtual environments.
we propose solutions to assist users to create 3D content, while preserving the shape and texture of the original model.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we have shown the possibility for a user with little or no expertise in computer graphics to make changes to digital content, while preserving the overall structure of the content and the lighting conditions.
non-expert users can use our tools to make simple changes to the shape of 3D models, as well as the lighting of both 3D models and photographs of natural scenes.
we can simplify the content creation process, while still preserving the quality of the content.
